title: Collect matched target power through the reciprocal launched feed
statement: For a fixed passive reciprocal source and reciprocal launcher,its same-feed return is h_z(u)=h0(u)+z a(u)/(1-sz),a(u)=(t^T u)^2 and |a(u)|=p(u). A fixed reciprocal lossy front end gives the same per-configuration two-port residue identity.

requires: Passive reciprocal power-normalized source and same-feed launch/return path
Known target load reference plane;other ports matched
provides: Scalar matched-target power equals residue magnitude without complete output collection
assumptions: Generic fixed receivers can be blind
Arbitrary command-dependent reflections need not define one fixed Gram
costs: Charge all raw powers,reference/signal photons,combiner loss,calibration,mask writes,load switching,settling and reset;no free parameter,clock or arbitrarily strong local oscillator.
contract.units: Dimensionless power per incident feed-power unit;field amplitude is its square root. r,z,s are complex reflection amplitudes;R is reference amplitude. Physical photon/time calibration remains an acquired input.
contract.obstruction: Reciprocity or a fitted response alone does not acquire load calibration,a fixed command map or settling.
